headline: Linn Mercy Quickens as Nevish Line Rekindles
war_summary: Since the last wire Linn Mercy has quickened to four transfers in two hours and thirty-two on the day about Lathair and Outwich Ranch for ten Colonial and one no-man's-land holding, last at 0846, while the Nevish Line has stirred again with two in two hours and thirty-three on the day about Blackcoat Way and Blinding Stones for six Warden and two Colonial holdings, last at 0831, alongside sharply accelerating casualties near seven thousand a side on the day. The Weathered Expanse remains the busiest desk with nine in two hours and forty-nine on the day about Crow's Nest, Wightwalk, Necropolis and Spirit Watch for three holdings apiece to Wardens, Colonials and no-man's-land, last at 0759. Mooring County has cooled to one in two hours and twenty-two on the day about the Wind Hills for eleven Warden and one Colonial holding, last at 0705, and Stlican Shelf shows one in two hours and seven on the day about Briar, last at 0736. Marban Hollow stays quiet with none in two hours and thirty on the day about Checkpoint Bua, last at 0346, and Callahan's Passage records heavy losses without a transfer.
